description: This file manages marketplace plugin operations including loading, validating, cloning repositories, handling downloads, and installing plugins from marketplace sources. It includes functions for parsing marketplace manifests, resolving plugin paths, and handling remote repository interactions.

methods.name: isHttpUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string is an HTTP or HTTPS URL.

methods.name: isGitUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string is a Git URL.

methods.name: looksLikeGitHubRepoShorthand
methods.description: Determines if a string looks like a GitHub repository shorthand.

methods.name: splitRef
methods.description: Splits a string into base URL and optional ref (after #).

methods.name: toOptionalString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string or undefined.

methods.name: normalizeEntrySource
methods.description: Normalizes raw input into a MarketplaceEntrySource object with validation.

methods.name: marketplaceEntrySourceToInput
methods.description: Converts a MarketplaceEntrySource to a string input representation.

methods.name: parseMarketplaceManifest
methods.description: Parses and validates a marketplace JSON manifest string.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a filesystem path exists.

methods.name: readClaudeKnownMarketplaces
methods.description: Reads known marketplaces from local JSON file.

methods.name: deriveMarketplaceRootFromManifestPath
methods.description: Derives marketplace root directory from manifest path.

methods.name: resolveLocalMarketplaceSource
methods.description: Resolves local marketplace source to directory and manifest path.

methods.name: normalizeGitCloneSource
methods.description: Normalizes a Git clone source URL and ref.

methods.name: cloneMarketplaceRepo
methods.description: Clones a marketplace repository from a URL.

methods.name: loadMarketplace
methods.description: Loads marketplace manifest from local or remote source.

methods.name: resolveSafeMarketplaceDownloadFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and derives a safe filename from a URL.

methods.name: resolveMarketplaceDownloadTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves download timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: formatMarketplaceDownloadError
methods.description: Formats an error message for marketplace download failures.

methods.name: hasStreamingResponseBody
methods.description: Checks if a Response has a streaming body.

methods.name: readMarketplaceChunkWithTimeout
methods.description: Reads a chunk from a stream with timeout.

methods.name: writeMarketplaceChunk
methods.description: Writes a chunk to a file handle.

methods.name: streamMarketplaceResponseToFile
methods.description: Streams response body to a file with size limit.

methods.name: downloadUrlToTempFile
methods.description: Downloads a URL to a temporary file with cleanup.

methods.name: ensureInsideMarketplaceRoot
methods.description: Ensures a path is inside the marketplace root directory.

methods.name: validateMarketplaceManifest
methods.description: Validates marketplace manifest entries for remote sources.

methods.name: resolveMarketplaceEntryInstallPath
methods.description: Resolves the installation path for a marketplace plugin entry.

methods.name: listMarketplacePlugins
methods.description: Lists plugins available in a marketplace.

methods.name: resolveMarketplaceInstallShortcut
methods.description: Resolves a shortcut string to a marketplace plugin.

methods.name: installPluginFromMarketplace
methods.description: Installs a plugin from a marketplace source.
